sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Secret Message is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "How do you feel about 12-gauge shotguns? And what about scavengers? Good. Let us combine the two for maximum efficiency. Clear the downtown using these weapons. Why? Because we intend to send a message to those who are meant to receive it. I cannot tell you anything more than that."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must reach Loyalty Level 2 with Peacekeeper to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate any 15 targets with headshots using a 12ga shotgun on Streets of Tarkov

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
- 1,100 Dollars
  - 1,155 Dollars with Intelligence center Level 1
  - 1,265 Dollars with Intelligence center Level 2
"Great job! The message has been sent and received."
